data.content:
Manager Giovanni Stroppa continues to deal with a lengthy injury list. Marin Sverko, Bartol Franjic, Ridgeciano Haps, Andrea Adorante and captain Gianluca Busio are among those unavailable, while Joel Schingtienne is struggling with an ankle problem.

                          Akor Adams is expected to lead the attack, with Yeboah providing support as Venezia search for a response.

                          ### Results of the last five matches [...] ### Probable line-up for Atalanta

                          M. Carnesecchi; R. Bellanova, T. Kristensen, G. Scalvini, L. Bernasconi; F. Kessié, Gaetano, Éderson; Charles De Ketelaere, Nikola Krstović, J. Rowe.

                          ## Venezia - Struggling for form

                          Now we will turn our attention to Venezia. We will analyse the team’s current form, recent results, and key players for the upcoming match in Bergamo. [...] Despite their recent struggles, Atalanta have won both home league matches this season, including a 1-0 win over Bologna. They have scored only six goals in seven competitive matches, as they adapt to Sarri’s methods following the end of the Gian Piero Gasperini era.

                          The hosts will again be without Isak Hien and Odilon Kossounou, while Giacomo Raspadori remains a doubt with a thigh strain. Kamaldeen Sulemana could return after a knee injury.
